## Checks

- [ ] `npm run ci` passes locally (lint, unit tests, both e2e files)
- [ ] New UI code is reached by an e2e scenario (`npm run coverage` lists anything missed)
- [ ] If the userscript changed: `@version` bumped and a CHANGELOG.md section added
- [ ] Tried on a live realestate.com.au rental search (optional, but say if you did)

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for layout, rules of thumb and how CI runs.
